signIn.title: Operations portal
signIn.body: For the Atesta team only. Sign in with your team account: it will ask for your passkey or your verification code.

noAccess.title: No access to the portal
noAccess.body: Your team account has no access or is disabled. Ask an admin to check it.

notFound.title: We could not find this page

organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.description: Customer organizations: their metadata only, never their content.

errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again, and tell the team channel if it keeps happening.

auth.bad_nonce: Sign-in could not be completed. Sign in again.
auth.bad_origin: A request that did not come from the portal was blocked. Reload the page.
auth.invalid_token: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
auth.provider_unavailable: We cannot verify your session right now. Try again in a few seconds.

request.error: The request could not be completed. Try again.
request.invalid: Check your input: one of the fields is not valid.
request.method_not_allowed: This action is not available. Reload the page.
request.not_found: We could not find that page or resource.

server.error: Something went wrong on our side. Try again, and tell the team channel if it keeps happening.
